description: This file contains logic for determining when to skip autocomplete suggestions based on the current editing context, including language-specific statement terminators and mid-word typing detection.

methods.name: getTerminatorsForLanguage
methods.description: Returns statement terminators for a given language ID, or default terminators if none are specified.

methods.name: isAtEndOfStatement
methods.description: Checks if the cursor is at the end of a statement based on language-specific terminators.

methods.name: isMidWordTyping
methods.description: Determines if the user is mid-word typing, which can influence autocomplete behavior.

methods.name: shouldSkipAutocomplete
methods.description: Main exported function that decides whether to skip autocomplete based on context.
